        return ''
    s = str(v).strip()
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s)
    return s.lower()

df['Village_norm'] = df['Village'].apply(norm_village)

# Deduplicate Visit ID keeping first occurrence
df_dedup = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['Visit ID'], keep='first')

import pandas as pd
import re

file_path = '/data/field_visit_log.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Field Visit Log', header=4)

# Normalize village just in case
def norm_village(v):
    if pd.isna(v):
        return ''
    s = str(v).strip()
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s)
    return s.lower()

df['Village_norm'] = df['Village'].apply(norm_village)

# Deduplicate by Visit ID keeping first occurrence
df_dedup = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['Visit ID'], keep='first')

# Filter
prog_col = df_dedup['Programme'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
state_col = df_dedup['State'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()

mask = (prog_col == 'health & nutrition') & (state_col == 'odisha')
filtered = df_dedup[mask]

total = filtered['Women Reached'].sum()
print('count rows', len(filtered))
print('total women', total)
# Show sum details
print(filtered[['Visit ID','State','Programme','Women Reached']].to_string(index=False))
